independentMeaning.masking: The first helper assertion masks the lease, human, bootstrap and null assertions at 171–174. The other 20 original cases pass. This is helper sensitivity, not a real authenticated HTTP agent result.

independentMeaning.firstFailure: All four named submittedBy variants receive 201 instead of 400 at original 135:26.
independentMeaning.meaning: The literal change removes strictness. The current route still supplies the authenticated context principal to submitJob and never reads submittedBy from the parsed body. Accepting or stripping this extra field does not establish a different forged identity.
independentMeaning.masking: The first status assertion masks persistedRows equality at 136. No post-failure SQL row snapshot was retained or independently reconstructed.

independentMeaning.firstFailure: Blank identity at 142:26, direct product route at 157:26 and registry omitted-principal at 165:26 receive 201 instead of 401.
independentMeaning.meaning: Ordinary anonymous and missing-identity delegated cases remain refused through earlier authentication/RBAC checks. The blank string is truthy at the injected RBAC seam and becomes empty only after trimming; direct route and registry cases isolate the route principal guard.
independentMeaning.masking: The corresponding row comparisons at 143, 158 and 166 are not reached after these first status failures. No anonymous live HTTP admission is established.

independentMeaning.firstFailure: The injected agent OPERATOR and lease OWNER fixtures receive 201 instead of 403 at original 142:26.
independentMeaning.meaning: Those explicit elevated roles avoid later RBAC masking. Actual AGENT-only HTTP credentials can still be denied by later role checks. These are supported injected-auth seams, not credential-authentication results.
independentMeaning.masking: The persistedRows equality at 143 is masked in both failing cases.

independentMeaning.firstFailure: The four named submittedBy variants receive 201 instead of 400 at original 135:26.
independentMeaning.meaning: The exact recovered replacement extends the body schema and shadows submitter inside the existing try block. The different nonempty someone-else value can select another principal in this source. sid selects the same principal; empty string and null fall back to the authenticated principal. The raw status failures do not show that all four inputs stored a different identity.
independentMeaning.masking: The row equality at 136 is masked. The four current reconstructed controls are not relabeled as four independently recovered historical recipes.

That function silently catches close errors, so no additional handle.open or cold-process guarantee is inferred from absence of surfaced cleanup errors.
